verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client that auto-categorizes and drafts replies, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence pack, however, only covers MCP email tools, self-hosting, and developer setup commands. Nothing documents versioning, change review, or rollback of automations or rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
